description: Lignes de tous les réseaux de transport en commun is a dataset listed in DATA Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence. La Métropole d’Aix-Marseille-Provence ouvre ses données publiques 'Transport' afin de promouvoir le développement d'applications dans ce domaine. Ce jeu de données, intitulé 'Lignes des réseaux de transport en commun', est un fichier GTFS "Routes" qui contient la description complète des lignes et des arrêts des différents réseaux partenaires opérant sous 'La Métropole Mobilité'. Coverage: Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis. The portal files it under Transports. Its keywords are transport, rtm, Mobilité, routes, arret, depart. The portal shows 769 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-07-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ampmetropole-fr-portal.
